summary: Frontend-only verification of Money tab (/home) hero card bug fix. All acceptance criteria pass: (1) Income value renders in GREEN #2BD47D (rgb 43,212,125) and Expenses in RED #FF7A7A (rgb 255,122,122) — confirmed via computed styles. (2) NET EARNINGS with a large amount ($20,100.00 added via ledger-add-income while All-time was selected) stays on a SINGLE LINE at fontSize 48 and does NOT overflow outside the hero GradientCard (measured: rect right 237px vs card right 359px, height 58px = one 48px line). (3) Period toggle (Today / This FY / All-time) still updates the hero — verified all three states show the added value under All-time and $0.00 under Today. (4) Test income entry deleted via ledger-history-toggle + ledger-del-* to leave data clean (final hero shows $0.00 income/expenses/net). Note: on the React Native Web preview, adjustsFontSizeToFit does not shrink the font (native-only behavior) — instead numberOfLines=1 causes the tail of the number to be truncated with ellipsis, visually showing '$20,100....' inside the card. This matches the fallback explicitly acknowledged in the review request and no overflow occurs.

issues: On web preview, adjustsFontSizeToFit is a no-op (native-only). Large amounts render truncated with ellipsis (e.g. '$20,100....') rather than shrinking. Contained inside the card and single-line, so meets the fallback bar stated in the request. If a nicer web fallback is desired, main agent could (a) reduce the base fontSize for the net figure to something like 32–36, or (b) use a JS-based fit-to-width shim on web only.

action_items: OPTIONAL polish (not blocking): improve web fallback for the hero net figure so large numbers aren't visually truncated with '....' on Expo Web (adjustsFontSizeToFit doesn't work on RN Web). Options: lower base size, use a Text with onLayout to auto-fit, or wrap in a View with a maxWidth and a shrink logic.

Money component in src/ui.tsx correctly forwards numberOfLines / adjustsFontSizeToFit / minimumFontScale to the underlying Text.
